name: Deploy Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main # Triggers the deploy every time you push to the main branch

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/watch-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Install Moonwave Suite
        run: npm install -g moonwave

      - name: Build Static Site Files
        run: npx moonwave build --docs docs

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          folder: build # The directory generated by the moonwave build command
          branch: gh-pages # Deploys site assets to a dedicated isolated branch
